newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 589,800 MT were two-fifths below the previous week and 14 percent under the 4-week average.

The primary buyers were Spain (192,600 MT), Egypt (70,000 MT), Taiwan (56,000 MT), Malaysia (55,000 MT), and Mexico (54,000 MT). Sales of 417,700 MT for delivery in 1997/98were mainly for unknown destinations (217,000 MT) and Japan (185,900 MT, including 40,600 MT switched from 1996/97).
Exports of 648,900 MT were one-third lower than the week earlier and 14 percent less than the 4-week average.
The primary destinations were Japan (250,700 MT), Mexico (122,900 MT), Portugal (81,500 MT), El Salvador (37,100 MT), and Spain (25,100 MT).
Note: The report for week ending May 22, included late reporting of sales for Japan (378,400 MT, of which 40,600 MT were switched to the 1997/98 marketing year in this report) and Taiwan (58,900 MT).
